subject.title: Write tool lacks append mode — isolated cron sessions destroy shared files

question: Should OpenClaw accept `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool as the permanent model-facing append contract for ordinary agent, cron, and monitor workflows?
rationale: The data-loss class is source-reproducible, but the remaining fix becomes a public tool API that agents, tests, and extension-observable events can rely on, so maintainer product/API intent is required before merge.

options.title: Accept append on write
options.body: Land the linked implementation after review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

options.title: Choose another append contract
options.body: Ask for a replacement shape such as `mode: "append"` or a dedicated append tool before merging any public API.

options.title: Defer code and document workarounds
options.body: Keep the issue open and rely on backup or shell-redirection workarounds while accepting that ordinary write calls still carry data-loss risk.

recommendation.title: Accept append on write
recommendation.body: Land the linked implementation after review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining question is product/API direction, and `steipete` already participated in a related append-scope decision for this issue cluster.
